title: Polyconvexity for Cosserat nonlinear elasticity and nonlinear couple-stress theory
summary: We study a class of nonlinear elastic energies whose constitutive structure is naturally expressed in terms of a stretch variable but is not directly covered by the standard polyconvex theory formulated in the deformation gradient. The problem is lifted by introducing an independent microrotation $ \overline R \in {\rm SO}(3)$ and the relative stretch $ \overline U = \overline R ^T{\rm D}\varphi$.
